title: Cut-off smooth pull-back test forms agreeing with F^#ω and F^#dω near a compact set
statement: For all N, N', k, every C^∞ map F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F), every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) = TestFormOn univ k and every compact K ⊆ ℝ^N there are η ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) and an open W ⊇ K such that for all x ∈ W, η(x) = (ω(F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x) and exteriorDerivative η x = (exteriorDerivative ω (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x).
lean_statement: ∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (F : Euclid N → Euclid N') (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N')) k) (K : Set (Euclid N)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) F → IsCompact K → ∃ (η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (W : Set (Euclid N)), IsOpen W ∧ K ⊆ W ∧ (∀ x ∈ W, (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)) ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x = (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid N') k) (F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x)
